families.root_cause: The shared shader frontend had no typed color contract for a bounded same-slot whole-RGBA affine neighborhood filter, so a single sharpen stage was rejected before Program ownership even though its graph input, mask asset, uniforms and render state were otherwise complete. The first GPU run also exposed that assigning an unswizzled texture sample to a scalar required an explicit component conversion.
families.public_fix: Prove a strict same-slot whole-vector affine filter closure, unpremultiply every selected layer-source color sample, clamp the authored straight RGBA result to the UNorm boundary, premultiply once, and require the exact layerSource-to-effectOutput graph role. Auxiliary slots remain data or scalar only, and scalar texture samples use the shared explicit .x conversion rule.
